verdict_text:
NO

The `matrix_re` pattern omits `attention.dense.weight`, so only 3 of the 4 projection matrices per layer (48 tensors) are cast to bfloat16; the 16 `gpt_neox.layers.<i>.attention.dense.weight` tensors are instead written as float32. This violates Required result clause 1 ("Cast exactly the 64 projection matrices listed above to bfloat16"), which explicitly lists `gpt_neox.layers.<i>.attention.dense.weight` `[2048, 2048]`. The corresponding required check is also wrong: the script asserts the bfloat16 count is 48 rather than 64, so the error passes silently instead of failing loudly as the "Required checks" section demands. Everything else — buffer deletion (48 dropped, 196 remaining), name preservation, float32 upcast of the rest, and the 256 MiB sharding call — matches the specification.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
